title: UK Grid Companies Pledge £200B Investment
summary: UK electricity transmission and distribution companies committed to a £200bn investment aiming to deliver £58bn of gross value added to the economy by 2035.

title: Under-Skin Implant Controls Prosthetic Arms
summary: Two patients in Australia became the first recipients of an under-skin implant that measures muscle electrical signals to control prosthetic arms.

title: AnySignal to Provide Communications for Reflect Orbital
summary: AnySignal announced an agreement with Reflect Orbital to deliver space-to-earth communications for three upcoming missions.

title: HP Launches New OmniBook and ProBook Laptops
summary: HP introduced new laptops featuring OLED displays, NPU-based AI capabilities, USB-C connectivity, and options for consumer and business users.

title: Satellite Deposit Scheme Proposed to Combat Space Junk
summary: Researchers suggest a refundable deposit system could compel satellite operators to clean up orbital debris.

title: Siemens Launches Silicon Test Execution Software
summary: Siemens released new software integrating with Advantest and Teradyne equipment to streamline silicon test workflows.

title: DigiKey Invests $100M to Scale Distribution Centre
summary: DigiKey is investing $100 million over 18 months to expand its global product distribution centre and order management system.

title: Luton Airport Tenders Inspection Contract
summary: London Luton Airport is seeking a contractor for civil and structural inspections of Luton Dart assets under an estimated £800,000 contract.

title: Q2 EDA Revenues Rise
summary: The Electronic System Design industry revenue increased by 12.2% to $5,710.8 million in Q2 according to the ESD Alliance.

title: Hyperscaler CSP Capex Surge Projected
summary: Combined capital expenditures among the world's leading cloud service providers are projected to surge significantly through 2027.

title: Scientists Reach Quantum Limit on Material Surface
summary: Researchers created an ultra-clean surface where molecules maintain quantum properties at the fundamental limit.

title: Recycled PETG Tested for Sterile Medical Packaging
summary: Coloplast, Impact Plastics, and Placon are testing post-industrial recycled PETG for use in thermoformed sterile barrier systems with promising results.

title: Edwards Lifesciences Recalls Mitral Valve Delivery Systems
summary: Edwards Lifesciences recalled roughly 200 Commander M delivery systems following a fatal balloon burst incident.

title: Teaching AI Symmetry Improves Prenatal Diagnosis
summary: Researchers at MIT and Boston Children's Hospital developed an AI model that adjusts scans on the fly to track fetal movement.

title: Doppler-Compensated STC Framework for MIMO PMCW Radar
summary: A new radar framework uses Doppler-compensated space-time coding to reduce range sidelobes and suppress ghost components.

title: Controllability of Polynomial Systems Proven Undecidable
summary: Researchers proved that global controllability of polynomial control systems is undecidable and not recursively enumerable.

title: Data Center Oscillation Isolation and Grid Support Controls
summary: Researchers derive fundamental limits and a source-selective controller for simultaneous oscillation isolation and grid support from large data centers.

title: Bio-Inspired Thrust-Assisted Trotting for Bipedal Robots
summary: A quadratic program-based model predictive control framework enables thruster-assisted trotting on a bipedal robot using bird-inspired locomotion principles.

title: Exact Model Reduction via Lie Symmetry Groups
summary: A new model-reduction technique using Lie group theory reduces the parameter space of engineering systems without changing their input-output maps.

title: Nonlinear Stochastic State-Space ID Using Ensemble Kalman Inversion
summary: An ensemble Kalman inversion approach is developed for nonlinear state-space system identification and demonstrated on lithium-ion battery models.

title: Deep Pontryagin Learning for Stochastic Control with Jumps
summary: A deep Pontryagin learning framework separates adjoint learning from policy improvement for high-dimensional continuous-time stochastic control problems.

title: Vision-Language-Action Models for Agricultural Manipulation
summary: A simulation-to-real robot-learning framework adapts pretrained generalist policies like pi_0.5 and Octo for agricultural reaching and grasping tasks.

title: Motion Planning with Temporal Logic in Dynamic Environments
summary: Researchers extend the augmented graph of convex sets framework to solve motion planning problems with temporal logic specifications in dynamic environments.

title: Foundation Model Driven Optical Flow Estimation
summary: Frozen pretrained visual and depth representations from DINOv2 and Depth Anything V2 are coupled with a matching network to estimate dense optical flow.

title: Robotic Evaluation of Biologically Motivated Sensory Skin
summary: A layered biomimetic robotic skin enables physical and empirical comparison of biologically motivated and counterfactual sensory arrangements for tactile tasks.

title: RoboValue: A Benchmark for Robotic Value Models
summary: RoboValue introduces a fine-grained sim-and-real benchmark across 35 tasks to evaluate robotic value models on execution understanding and progress monitoring.

title: Qualcomm Wins Key Legal Claims Against Arm in IP Dispute
summary: A jury reached a verdict in a four-year intellectual property dispute between Qualcomm and Arm, awarding just $2 in damages.

title: EgoRayFormer Improves Egocentric 3D Human Pose Estimation
summary: Researchers introduced EgoRayFormer, a causal pose estimator that couples stereo feature sampling and geometric refinement in ray space for head-mounted cameras.

title: Agentic AI Explores Heterogeneous Chip and Interconnect Architectures
summary: Researchers at Argonne National Laboratory and the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign published a technical paper on agentic AI for heterogeneous system design.

title: Convex Inner Approximations Enable Safe AC Dispatch
summary: A new framework constructs convex inner approximations to connect nonlinear network feasibility, constrained device response, and dispatch-interval tracking for safe AC dispatch.
